column3: Retains name in the singular and repeats Zelophehad.
Retains sons of Ephraim and their clans, then sons of Joseph and their clans.
Does not include the added second from Ard.
Retains sons of Benjamin and their clans.
Repeats according to their clans at the end.
Retains the enrolled ones of the sons of Israel.
Says to these rather than explicitly supplying tribes.
Retains his inheritance and the passive it shall be given.
Retains the mouth of the lot.
Retains the active Kohath fathered Amram.
